answer: Payouts are weighted by a trust graph where an agent's share comes only from stake bonded against future earnings, slashed if its attestations overlap a cluster flagged as one operator. Farming identities means posting that bond on every fake account at once and keeping internal links shallow enough to dodge detection. Since the bond exceeds per-epoch yield, expected profit turns negative fast; a wide grove of independent partners costs each extra clone more capital, and a cheap opal key in an isolated zephyr of fresh accounts buys nothing without neighbours risking their own bonds.
